Re: 
Disclosure under regulations 30 and 46(2)(oa) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“the Listing Regulations”) 
 
 
Pursuant to the provisions of regulations 30 and 46(2)(oa) of the Listing Regulations, we 
hereby inform that the audio recording of the Company’s Investor Call discussing about the 
unaudited financial results for the quarter ended on June 30, 2026, is available on the 
Company’s website.  
 
The link to access the said audio recording is as under: 
 
https://zyduslife.com/public/pdf/Audio-Recording-of-Investor-Call-11-Aug-2026.mp3 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For, Zydus Lifesciences Limited
